sources: arXiv paper search and full-text protocols

inclusion_rule: Reusable benchmark or evaluation contribution with a public primary source and a measurement object inside the Radar scope. Methods without a distinct evaluation contribution are excluded.
note: Discovery reviewed through 2026-09-17, with bounded historical backfill. Intermittent source-access failures mean this is not an exhaustive census. Unverified candidates stay outside public inventory. Citation and result verification remain separate; existing snapshots are unchanged.
